signaling_summary: All-digital low-voltage-swing low-power signaling. Command/address (CA[6:0]) and CS are single-ended low-power-swing inputs referenced to Vref(ca); DQ / DMI are single-ended referenced to Vref(dq). CK_t/CK_c (quarter-speed master clock), WCK_t/WCK_c (full-speed write clock) and RDQS_t/RDQS_c (read strobe) are differential. VDDQ (the DQ/IO supply) is reduced to 0.5 V — substantially lower than DDR3's 1.5 V — to minimize IO power. Core supplies are VDD1 (~1.8 V) and VDD2H/VDD2L (selected by DVFSC for dynamic core voltage scaling). The receiver employs Decision Feedback Equalization (DFE) and (in JESD209-5B) tx/rx equalization to maintain signal integrity at 6400+ Mbit/s. The ZQ pin provides a calibration reference against an external precision resistor that the on-die calibration engine uses to trim output-driver and on-die-termination impedance over Process / Voltage / Temperature.

voltage_classes.applicable: JESD209-5B / JESD209-5X, up to 8533 Mbps; SI improvements with tx/rx equalization

supply_rails.VDD1: First core supply (~1.8 V) — charge-pump / wordline / high-voltage core domain.
supply_rails.VDD2H: Second core / periphery supply, HIGH operating point — selected by DVFSC at higher frequencies.
supply_rails.VDD2L: Second core / periphery supply, LOW operating point — selected by DVFSC at lower frequencies for power saving.
supply_rails.VDDQ: DQ / IO supply, reduced to 0.5 V for low IO power.

reference_voltages.Vref_ca: Reference voltage for CA / CS input thresholds; internally generated and trimmable per frequency set point.
reference_voltages.Vref_dq: Reference voltage for DQ / DMI input thresholds; internally generated and trimmable per frequency set point (DVFSQ).

equalization.DFE: Decision Feedback Equalization on the LPDDR5 receiver to cancel ISI at high data rates.
equalization.tx_rx_eq: Transmit and receive equalization added in JESD209-5B (LPDDR5/5X) for signal-integrity headroom up to 8533 Mbps.

zq_calibration.purpose: Trim DRAM output driver impedance and on-die termination against an external precision reference resistor on the ZQ pin to compensate Process / Voltage / Temperature drift.
zq_calibration.external_reference: Precision resistor between the ZQ pin and ground (per JESD209-5 ZQ specification).
zq_calibration.commands: ZQ calibration start / latch via MPC (multi-purpose command) per the LPDDR5 calibration flow.

notes: Although the LPDDR5 bus is digital, the DRAM array itself is fundamentally analog (1T1C cells, sense amplifiers, charge pumps, on-die clock generation / DLL/PLL for WCK, DFE, and the ZQ calibration engine). Those internal analog details are vendor-specific and intentionally out of scope of the JESD209-5 standard, which deals only with bus-level signaling at the package balls. The defining low-voltage feature versus DDR3 is the 0.5 V VDDQ and the per-frequency-set-point Vref / DVFSC voltage scaling.
